scope_comparison: Exact benchmark algorithms and an 84-gon bound do not prove many-one NP-hardness of the exact rational-threshold binary-input triangulation problem. Edge-budget graphs, trees, oriented cycles and minimum-total-length triangulations have different admissible objects or objectives. The 2026 oriented-spanner paper explicitly retains the plane undirected question.
